sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Pray for one another.
Read

The Bible tells us that if we confess our sins to God and believe that Jesus’ sacrifice paid for our sins, we can be forgiven. When our sins are forgiven, then our relationship with God our Creator is restored, just as it was before Adam and Eve sinned. And this story is from the word of God.

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.
Read

These verses teach us that Jesus came to His disciples in their fear and doubt, not to condemn them, but to bring peace and faith.  Jesus calls you to believe as well! Turn from sin and believe in Jesus alone — that He died for your sins and rose again. Repent and believe, that you may have life in His name.

To believe in Jesus is also to call Him Lord — to become His disciple, to trust Him, follow Him, and learn from Him.  Jesus will give you a new heart through the promised gift of the Holy Spirit. When we believe in Jesus, the Holy Spirit makes us children of God, and seals us forever in the love of God.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Do
Do you believe in Jesus Christ?
If you are ready, let’s pray together, and ask God to help us turn from sin and believe in Jesus Christ. Let’s thank Him for the gift of new life, and for becoming His beloved children.
If you are not ready, then what is stopping you from believing in Jesus Christ?
Ask
I hope you enjoyed this story. When can we meet again?
Do you think someone else should hear this story?
